title: Quarterly restore drill
transcript:
[00:00] Hiroshi: Quarterly restore drill. Auditors want evidence by the end of the month.
[00:06] Delphine: I'll run it. Restore last night's production snapshot into the isolated drill account.
[00:12] Hiroshi: When?
[00:16] Delphine: Thursday the 12th, starting 10:00 Central. It takes about three hours.
[00:21] Hiroshi: And what counts as a pass?
[00:25] Delphine: The restore finishes within four hours, row counts match the snapshot manifest for every table, and the app logs in against it.
[00:34] Hiroshi: Good. Write it up in the drill log by Friday the 13th, with screenshots.
[00:40] Delphine: Drill log by Friday the 13th. Yes.
[00:44] Hiroshi: I'll forward it to the auditors the following Monday.
[00:48] Delphine: Sounds good.
